title: History + Personal Patterns

backend.services/history.py: Deterministic Health Episode projection from sealed L6 history (daily_reasoning + personal_context + user_feedback). Consecutive same-theme notable days merge; stable days hidden but counted; read-model keyed by (user_id, episode_key) updated in place; vanished episodes marked SUPERSEDED; keyword search over summaries/event details. Zero model calls.
backend.services/today.py (patterns): Added display_status semantics: ESTABLISHED / WEAKENED (support<50% at total>=4) / INVALIDATED (support==0 at total>=4) / OBSERVING. Weakened/invalidated patterns now surface because counterevidence is itself actionable. Single events never surface.

app.history_screen.dart: Real episode list with phase chip (进行中/恢复中/已结束), search box, stable-day-hidden counter, episode timeline detail (judgment/context/feedback events)
app.patterns_screen.dart: display_status rendered (已确立/正在减弱/已被反例否定/观察中) + counterevidence

phase_f_cases: episodes from real sealed data (SLEEP_DEFICIT 2026-08-16 DEVELOPING)
multi-day grouping + stable-day hiding + phase CLOSED for non-latest
rebuild idempotent (stable read-model identity, no event duplication)
vanished episode marked SUPERSEDED not deleted
tests.flutter: analyze 0 errors; widget tests 5/5 PASS (FakeClient extended)
